subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept subagent completion announce handoffs as always tool-free and reconcile interrupted announce runs to non-running `killed` session state via `announceLastRun`?
rationale: The remaining choice changes both persisted restart-recovery semantics and an internal tool boundary, so automation should not silently approve it even though the patch is coherent and well-proven.

options.title: Rebase, clear lint, and land
options.body: After conflicts and `check-lint` are resolved, merge this as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation behavior.

options.title: Change the recovery terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired persisted state for aborted delivery-only announce runs, request that state adjustment before merge.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery model
options.body: If maintainers want one recovery model for all inter-session delivery turns, pause this PR and design that owner boundary first.

recommendation.title: Rebase, clear lint, and land
recommendation.body: After conflicts and `check-lint` are resolved, merge this as the canonical announce recovery and tool-isolation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent restart lifecycle and Codex internal-turn history make this the closest available owner for the session-state/tool-boundary decision.
